canonical_encoding.embedded_hashing: SHA-256 of canonical JSON bytes without a terminal newline
canonical_encoding.file_hashing: SHA-256 of exact file bytes including the one terminal newline
canonical_encoding.json: UTF-8; duplicate keys rejected; exact keys only; booleans are not integers; finite values only; object keys sorted; separators comma and colon without spaces; ensure_ascii false; one terminal newline for files

category_predicates.application: root app; contains no let; contains a lambda and at least one beta redex
category_predicates.lambda: root lam; contains no app or let; at least one lambda body uses its binder
category_predicates.let: root let; contains no app; at least one let body uses its binder
category_predicates.mixed: root let; contains all of pi, lam, app and let; contains at least one beta redex and one active zeta redex
category_predicates.pi: root pi; contains no lam, app or let; at least one Pi body uses its binder

claim_limits: The generator and auditor provide two implementations of a bounded formal contract, not semantic authority.
Observer agreement is not semantic authority.
The result applies only to the exact corpus, producer, profiles and tooling bindings.
Producer compilation and export are engineering preparation; expected validity is derived from the frozen rules and independent audit.

derivation_contract.independence: The auditor is a separate module and must not import generator inference, normalization, shift, substitution, category or derivation helpers. Sharing is limited to reading this design and standard-library canonical JSON primitives.
derivation_contract.witness_requirement: The auditor recomputes rule-specific universe, lookup, normalized conversion and substitution results and requires the exact witness object emitted by its own contract.

deterministic_selection.randbelow: Consume unsigned 64-bit big-endian words with rejection sampling; never use language runtime random.
deterministic_selection.repair: A tooling repair regenerates the complete staged cohort from the unchanged design and seeds; preserve every failed construction attempt.
deterministic_selection.selection: In category order then slots 0 through 9, select the first generated candidate satisfying its exact category and size predicates whose canonical term hash is not already selected. The constructive templates must make attempt zero eligible and unique for every frozen slot; any nonzero selection attempt is a design violation. The independent auditor is not a selection predicate.

matrix.order: observer profile order, then case order

metrics_contract.semantics: constructor_counts, node_count, ast_depth and maximum_input_sort_level are recomputed from the input term. normalized_type_nodes and maximum_derived_sort_level are recomputed from expected_type_nf. binder_depth increments only through Pi, lambda and let body edges whose contexts extend, not through their domain, annotation or value edges. All values are nonnegative integers; booleans are rejected as integers.

observer_profiles.success_contract: exit 0; stdout matches ^Accepted [0-9]+ declarations[.]\n$; stderr empty
exit 0; preserve stdout and stderr exactly

source_rendering.artifact_granularity: one dependency-closed NDJSON export per declaration

typing_contract.context: Innermost binder first. An entry is stored relative to its tail. bvar i has type shift(context[i], i+1, 0).
typing_contract.definitional_equality: Exact de Bruijn AST equality after strong beta-zeta normalization. Eta, proof irrelevance, delta, iota, recursors and constants are excluded.
typing_contract.normalization: Strong beta-zeta normalization only, with congruence. Fail closed on fuel or size exhaustion.

rules.app: If Gamma |- f : T, beta-zeta-WHNF(T)=Pi A B, Gamma |- a : A' and A' is definitionally equal to A, then Gamma |- App f a : subst0(B,a).
rules.bvar: Gamma |- bvar i : shift(Gamma[i],i+1,0) when i is in range
rules.lam: If Gamma |- A : Sort u and A::Gamma |- t : B, then Gamma |- Lam A t : Pi A B.
rules.let: If Gamma |- A : Sort u, Gamma |- v : V, V is definitionally equal to A, and A::Gamma |- b : B, then Gamma |- Let A v b : subst0(B,v). The annotation and value checks precede zeta reduction.
rules.pi: If Gamma |- A : Sort u and A::Gamma |- B : Sort v, then Gamma |- Pi A B : Sort (0 if v=0 else max(u,v)).

typing_contract.shift: shift(e,k,c) increments bvar j when j>=c; recurse under Pi, lambda and let bodies at c+1 and through all other children at c.
typing_contract.substitution: subst(e,v,d) leaves bvar j when j<d, replaces j=d with shift(v,d,0), decrements j>d, recurses under Pi/lambda/let bodies at d+1 and elsewhere at d. subst0 uses d=0.
